fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: # India's Cockroach movement supporters gather to attempt a march to Parliament. Thousands of supporters of India’s youth-led Cockroach movement have gathered in New Delhi to march to Parliament to demand the education minister’s resignation. Supporters of the Cockroach Janta Party shout slogans during a protest demanding the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over alleged examination irregularities and repeated paper leaks in Mumbai, India, Sunday, July 19, 2026. NEW DELHI — Thousands of supporters of the youth-led Cockroach movement gathered Monday to march to India’s Parliament, demanding the resignation of the education minister despite police denying permission for the protest. Scores of police surrounded the barricaded protest site ​of Jantar Mantar in the heart of New Delhi, raising the prospect of a confrontation just a few kilometers from Parliament if demonstrators pressed ahead with the march. They are demanding the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, reforms to the examination system and compensation for the families of students who died by suicide following paper leaks.

fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: Summer uptick of virus may have begun in California. COVID-19 is on the upswing in California and across a swath of the West and the South, a sign that the virus may be starting its seasonal summer uptick. Wastewater concentrations are also increasing,” according to Grant Boyken, a spokesperson for the California Department of Public Health. That’s lower than at the same time in the prior two years, but it’s still an increase from a month ago, when the test positivity rate was 1.15%. According to health officials and experts, it wouldn’t be surprising for a summer increase in COVID to begin now. The test positivity rate is also increasing in Orange County, with 3% of COVID tests coming back positive for the week that ended July 11, up from 1.3% a month ago. fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: # The Air India First Class Lounge Delhi Is Delightful… What A Treat! After my Turkmenistan Airlines 777 and 737 business class adventure, it’s time to fly Air India’s 777 first class from Delhi (DEL) to Frankfurt (FRA). Okay, I must admit, my primary motive for flying Air India wasn’t the flight as such (since I’ve heard… not great things), but instead, to check out the new Air India Maharaja Lounge Delhi, which has both a first class and business class section. While I’ll publish a full review of both sections of the lounge soon, I’d like to share some initial musings on my visit to the first class lounge (hint: I think this will make my updated rankings of the world’s best first class lounges). ## The Air India first lounge Delhi is small but impressive. The new Air India first class lounge is a lovely little facility. The dining and service in Air India’s first class lounge are really what makes this exquisite, in my opinion.
